ncape01.title: The Handover
ncape01.caption: Sag tossed over the keys. Capricorn changed the password, posted a calendar and tucked Sag into bed. Longest night of the year, earliest bedtime. Welcome to Cap season.

ncape02.title: Cap Plans Date Two
ncape02.caption: Capricorn planned date two to the minute: 6:04 compliment, 6:07 laugh. Then crossed it all out for one better line. What's your ideal second date?

ncape03.title: Cap Doesn't Cry
ncape03.caption: Capricorn does not cry at movies. Capricorn does, it turns out, shed one tear over a small handmade card. Allergies, obviously. Who's your secret softie?

ncape04.title: The Seating Chart
ncape04.caption: Capricorn brought a color-coded seating chart and a ruler. Then gave its own seat to the new grandma without a second thought. Tag the planner who always makes room.

ncape05.title: Cap Wraps a Gift
ncape05.caption: Capricorn: forty minutes, perfect corners, a level. Sagittarius: three seconds, one ball of tape. Only one of them hid a letter inside. Which wrapper are you?

ncape06.title: Cap Says One Yes
ncape06.caption: Four party invites. Capricorn picks one, shows up on time with a gift and actually listens. Are you a one-party or an every-party person?

ncape07.title: Cap's Snow Day
ncape07.caption: Capricorn's plans got snowed in, so it drew a blueprint for a snowman. The lumpy one still made the photo. Best day you never planned?

ncape08.title: Cap's Year in Love
ncape08.caption: Capricorn's year in love, in slides. Say how I feel: done, once. Rest: working on it. Then Sag showed up with a review of its own. What's your goal for next year?

nsage01.title: Sag Has the Password
nsage01.caption: Sag got the password and immediately banned small talk. Dinner is now a night hike. Breadsticks are allowed. Which rule would you break first?

nsage02.title: The Packing List
nsage02.caption: Packed a passport and a whole tent for a first date, then realized all you really need is one good question. Who in your life overpacks for feelings?

nsage03.title: Honest to a Fault
nsage03.caption: Sagittarius will tell you the jacket is a lot. Sagittarius will also tell you to wear it, because you look that happy in it. Tag your honest-but-sweet friend.

nsage04.title: Sag's Itinerary
nsage04.caption: Day 1: wake up. Day 2: figure it out. Turns out the real plan was saying the scary thing out loud. Planner or winger, which one are you?

nsage05.title: Sag Says It First
nsage05.caption: Said 'I like you' at the café counter. It worked. Also, three muffins. Have you ever panic-ordered after a big confession?

nsage06.title: Sag Texts Back
nsage06.caption: One careful paragraph from Scorpio. One 'yes!!' from Sag, two seconds later. Thursday is booked. Are you a fast replier or a careful drafter?

nsage07.title: Sag on the Couch
nsage07.caption: Sag on movie night: body on the couch, brain on a mountain, a ferris wheel and a hot-air balloon. Then one question brought it home. Who's your 'where are you right now?' person?

nsage08.title: Sag Throws a Party
nsage08.caption: Sag invited everyone. Cancer quietly fed all of them. Every great party has a kitchen hero, so who's yours?

nsage09.title: The Honest Toast
nsage09.caption: Never hand Sag the mic. Every toast starts like a roast and ends with someone tearing up into their cocoa. Who would you toast first?

nsage10.title: Sag's Mystery Match
nsage10.caption: The blind mystery card said homebody. Sag said adventure. A blanket fort with the whole night sky on the ceiling said both. Staying in or going out tonight?

nsage11.title: Ask Sag Anything
nsage11.caption: Ask Sag anything and the answer is probably yes. Text first? Yes. Bring snacks? Obviously. Cry on a first date? Sag's bringing tissues. What would you ask?

nsage12.title: The Scrapbook
nsage12.caption: A whole month of Sag in one scrapbook: the packing list, the toast, the party of forty. And someone with a planner is peeking at the next page. Favorite Sag moment?
